author: dirtyred
quote: Save your money and wait until this is on special, it's not worth the RRP they're asking. The graphics and physics are fantastic but that's not what made GTA great, it's the unapologetic the characters and great story. This has non of that, it's woke narrative will see this likely become the most disliked title in the series. If it was a disc I'd have gone and asked for a refund.
